title: Bug: libyang3-dev and libyang1-dev cannot coexist
author: bhouse-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

libyang1-dev and libyang3-dev cannot coexist, so build ordering needs to be strictly enforced to ensure the right libyang dev package is installed for what is being built.

As of Trixie, during high parallel builds libyang3-dev will be installed then libswsscommon is built which expects libyang1 and the build fails.

### Steps to Reproduce

Build with parallelism of 16 and notice the build failure.  Re-running make after the failure usually continues due to it recreating the slave and only installing what it needs to continue the build.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

It should order builds appropriately.

linkedPullRequests.title: Serialize builds of packages needing libyang3-dev vs libyang1-dev
linkedPullRequests.author: bhouse-nexthop
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### Why I did it

During highly-parallel builds packages may fail due to dependencies being
overwritten.

libyang1-dev and libyang3-dev are not designed to coexist.  The way SONiC
builds, however, it depends on libyang3-dev being installed first
anything that needs it being built then, and only then, should
libyang1-dev be installed, and the remaining packages can then be built.

#### How I did it

This adds a new concept of Phony targets and adds the phony target to
libyang1 for libyang3-dev-done.  libyang1 won't even be built until
everything needing libyang3-dev is done.

Any package that relies directly on $(LIBYANG3_DEV) needs to be listed
as a dependency for libyang3-dev-done.

#### How to verify it

Build with 16 simultaneous jobs and notice it does not fail.
